name: @aimino/stas-mcp
description: MCP server for STAS — Solving Tickets As A Service. Submit GitHub issues, list runs, search codebase, and get automated fix PRs via OpenCode agents.

list_issues.description: List tracked issues and their STAS fix status

run_fix.description: Trigger the STAS fix pipeline for a GitHub issue URL.

check_status.description: Check the current status of a STAS fix run by run_id.

get_pr.description: Get the PR URL and details for a completed STAS fix run.

search_codebase.description: Search STAS codebase for symbols, files, or patterns.

stas://issues/{issue_id}.description: Issue details with fix status and PRs.
